replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, often. The complexity and my lack of practice make me feel anxious. It reminds me of my gaps in education, which triggers stress. My high neuroticism makes this worse, especially when I face unfamiliar equations.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: No, I haven’t. I prefer learning through books and discussions. AI seems impersonal, and my moderate openness to new experiences makes me skeptical about relying on it for math, which I already struggle with.
replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, write the equation in ax² + bx + c = 0 form. Then, calculate the discriminant (b² - 4ac).
